name: joplin-plugin-akiratamcat-favorites-i18n
description: Save any notebook, note, to-do, tag, or search as favorite in an extra panel view for quick access. Personal test build with UI translations (gettext PO).
author: benji300, Aron Wu (ARON-HACK), akira tamcat

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
